parameters.name: CrossAccountOwnerId
parameters.description: The owner of the cross-account management relationship.

parameters.name: ManagementMode
parameters.description:
The cross-account management mode. Valid values:

- AUTO: automatic management.
- MANUAL: manual management.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return.

parameters.name: TargetId
parameters.description: The ID of the cross-account management target.

parameters.name: TargetType
parameters.description:
The type of the cross-account management target. Valid values:

- ACCOUNT: account.
- RESOURCE_DIRECTORY: resource directory.
- FOLDER: resource folder.
